# cycle_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Cycle hub API key (`/v1/api-keys`). Permissions come from `role_id`; there is no separate capabilities field. The `secret` is returned only at create time; subsequent reads keep the value already stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cycle_hub_role" "ci" {
  name       = "CI Deploy"
  identifier = "ci-deploy"
  rank       = 2

  capabilities = {
    specific = [
      "environments-view",
      "containers-view",
    ]
  }
}

# The secret is returned only at create time and is marked sensitive.
# Permissions come from role_id; there is no capabilities field on the key.
resource "cycle_api_key" "ci" {
  name    = "github-actions"
  role_id = cycle_hub_role.ci.id
  ips     = ["203.0.113.10"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the API key.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the hub role this API key inherits permissions from.

### Optional

- `ips` (List of String) An allowlist of IP addresses that may use this API key. An empty list means the key is unrestricted.

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this API key belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the API key.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The API key secret. Returned on create; later reads preserve the value from state when the API omits it.
- `state` (String) The current state of the API key (e.g. `live`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# API keys are imported using their ID.
terraform import cycle_api_key.ci 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21
```
